body: Why did a month of biochemistry just happen in two hours?
Watching a recording of myself talking to a standardized patient was not as painful as I expected it to be. :)

Did not pass out today meeting my first patient (a cadaver).
"Hic est locus ubi mors gaudet succurrere vitae."
Its time to become a doctor.

Moved out of my house of the past two years today. Right before I left for the last time, I took a porch brick and wrote, "This is a special place." Hoping that message transmits to the next residents. I will miss this place dearly.
